# Onboarding

In your first week:

1. Ask for a bastion account in #access; you need it for every production host.
2. Set up the VPN and two-factor login.
3. Read the runbooks, then shadow the on-call rotation for a week before you join it.

Laptops come with the dev tools; ask IT for Docker Desktop if it is missing.
